title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: ElfLiq's Menthol offers a brisk and refreshing menthol experience, perfect for those who enjoy a clean and cooling vape. The flavour provides an icy exhale, making it an excellent choice for vapers seeking a fresh and simple vape liquid profile. ElfLiq e-liquids are crafted in 10ml bottles, offering a balanced 50VG/50PG blend that provides both rich flavour and ample vapour production. This nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for use in MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits, including vape starter kits and pod vape devices, delivering a consistent and smooth throat hit. The nicotine salt formulation ensures that this e-liquid provides a higher nicotine concentration compared to traditional freebase e-liquids, but with a smoother throat hit. Nicotine salts also allow for faster absorption into the bloodstream, providing rapid relief from nicotine cravings. This makes ElfLiq Nic Salts an excellent option for recent ex-smokers and those seeking to replicate the experience of traditional tobacco. ElfLiq e-liquids offer a versatile alternative to disposable vape devices, delivering longer-lasting enjoyment and reducing waste. They also share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable counterparts, ensuring a comfortable and effective all-day vaping experience.
